title: Listening Drill — Tram depot
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Tram depot
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the tram depot. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the ticket hall. The visit itself will last fifty minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a notebook.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the repair shed. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: some trams are still in service. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
